blocks.text: 🪝 AM/NS India Approved as 1st Anchor Partner Under ₹60,000-Cr PM-SETU Scheme. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Andhra Pradesh becomes 1st state to operationalise industry-led management of ITIs.
Anchor Partner: ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India approved for Visakhapatnam ITI cluster under PM-SETU.
PM-SETU Mandate: Upgrades 1,000 government ITIs across India using a hub-and-spoke model.
Steering Committee: National Steering Committee chaired by Skill Secretary Debashree Mukherjee.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on nodal central ministry, total financial outlay, funding split ratio, beneficiary eligibility, and target milestone year.
